svg.title: Ribbon bore 2 of 3 - 25mm square bore, 30 degree facets, serpentine
svg.desc: 1 user unit = 1mm. A duct of constant 25 x 25mm section swept along a planar curve. Two identical cheeks (0, both the same way up) and 50 wall panels numbered along the flow. The section is exact along every facet and 3.5% over at each mitre. 3mm ply, 0.1mm kerf, 0mm play per side taken out of the slot and never off the tab. blue #0000ff engraves, orange #ff8000 cuts the slots first, black #000000 frees the parts.
